the educators' general pedagogical and ICT pedagogical belief structures are different, and that their ICT pedagogic beliefs are based on a mixture of their perceptions of ICT and the influences they have received outside the early childhood education context.

The main takeaway from our work is that
early childhood educators have positive ICT pedagogial beliefs, and that the foundations of those positive beliefs are based on the perceived benefits of different ICT devices and software.
